title: StockSmart Pause and Credit Hold Terms by Tier — Quick Reference
content:
Quick reference for the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program: how long and how often a customer may pause a program, and what happens to replenishment while the customer's Commercial Credit Account is on hold.

| Tier | Longest customer-requested pause, calendar days | Customer-requested pauses allowed in a rolling 12 months | Monthly minimum and onsite fee prorated away for paused days | Replenishment while the credit account is on hold | Largest replenishment value per visit of critical bins while on hold, USD |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| StockSmart Self-Scan | 30 | 1 | yes | suspend | 0.00 |
| StockSmart Monthly Service | 30 | 1 | yes | suspend | 0.00 |
| StockSmart Biweekly Service | 45 | 2 | yes | suspend | 0.00 |
| StockSmart Weekly Service | 60 | 2 | yes | critical items only | 1500.00 |
| StockSmart Twice-Weekly Service | 60 | 2 | yes | critical items only | 3000.00 |
| StockSmart Onsite Storeroom | 90 | 3 | yes | critical items only | 10000.00 |

### Questions this table answers

**Which tiers keep replenishing during a credit hold?** StockSmart Weekly Service, StockSmart Twice-Weekly Service and StockSmart Onsite Storeroom, whose rule is critical items only, each with its own per-visit limit for critical bins (1500.00, 3000.00 and 10000.00). The three lower tiers suspend replenishment.

**Is the monthly minimum prorated for paused days on every tier?** Yes; the proration figure is yes on all six tiers.

**How many customer-requested pauses may a StockSmart Onsite Storeroom program take?** 3 in a rolling 12 months, each up to 90 calendar days.
